name: JW Marriott Cannes
positioning: Contemporary seafront hotel on the Croisette in Cannes, built on the site of the original Palais des Festivals, with a cinema-themed design, a rooftop pool and a partner beach across the boulevard
best_for: Travelers who want a seafront Croisette base a 5-minute walk from the Palais des Festivals
Film lovers drawn to a cinema-themed hotel

facts.text: The hotel is on the Croisette in Cannes, with contemporary design, sea views and a seafront setting.
Palais Stéphanie Beach is the hotel's partner beach, across La Croisette from the hotel.
The hotel is built on the site of the original Palais des Festivals, and its rooms feature portraits of famous film actors as a tribute to cinema.
The hotel has a signature cinema theme with leather-clad walls.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Mediterranean, the gardens or the city.
Bathrooms are made entirely of marble and wood.
Beds are plush pillowtop beds with deluxe linens.
The hotel has a rooftop swimming pool and is a 5-minute walk from the Palais des Festivals.
Scalini serves traditional Italian cuisine in a modern restaurant with an open kitchen.
The Palais Stéphanie Beach restaurant serves an international menu with Japanese specialities and views of the Lérins Islands and Estérel mountains.
Families are welcome, with spacious connecting rooms.
Golden Key concierges handle local recommendations, restaurant reservations and customized activities.

highlights.text: Each room has a headboard with photos of Cannes Film Festival celebrities.
Sea-view rooms look out to the coastline and the Lérins Islands, from the room or a balcony.
Sea-view luxury suites have panoramic views of the Mediterranean and the Croisette through expansive windows.
Le Panorama Rooftop is seasonal, with panoramic views over the Bay of Cannes, the Lérins Islands and the Estérel mountains.

considerations.text: The beach is Palais Stéphanie Beach, a partner beach across La Croisette from the hotel.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
